answer: Look — what if every mask on this stage answers to one thread behind the velvet curtain, the funding root no player can shed? When one mask cheats, that single signal of fraud condemns the whole troupe: every mask sharing the thread forfeits its bond at once, judged from the mesa where independent watchers compare notes. Ten masks cheating together lose ten bonds in one fall, while one honest player risks only one. A fleet cannot quarantine its losses — each extra mask raises the odds that one slip ruins all. One player, one mask, one honest part — that is the whole play.
